Title: General Availability: Azure Automation supports Python 3.8 runbooks

Body.Content:
Azure Automation support for Python 3.8 runbooks is now Generally Available for both cloud & hybrid jobs. This enables authoring and execution of Python runbooks for orchestration of management tasks across Azure, Arc and multi-cloud environments. It also provides the ability to upload Python packages and import them in runbooks.

Learn more about Azure Automation Runbooks and Python Packages.
